```{r setup}
#| include: false
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(jsonlite)
  library(lme4)
  library(lmerTest)
  library(emmeans)
  library(multcomp)
  library(MuMIn)
  library(knitr)
})
emm_options(lmer.df = "asymptotic")

cyt_cols <- c(
  ory_2x = "#3b82f6",
  nat_2x = "#10b981",
  nat_4x = "#f59e0b",
  neo_4x = "#ef4444"
)
cyt_levels <- names(cyt_cols)

theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9.5),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#f3f4f6", colour = NA),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9.5)
    )
)

p_rel <- function(rel) if (file.exists(rel)) rel else file.path("..", rel)

# 1. Load calibrated slide summary (with 3D stereological & mesh columns)
slides_raw <- read.csv(p_rel("output/qc/final_viability.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  filter(!is.na(cytotype), cytotype %in% cyt_levels) %>%
  mutate(
    cytotype = factor(cytotype, levels = cyt_levels),
    population = factor(population),
    plant_id = factor(plant_id),
    cultivation_run = factor(cultivation_run),
    total_grains = Count_detected,
    viability_pct = Viability_pct_detected
  )

m3d_cyt <- read.csv(p_rel("outcomes/pollen_3d_cytotype_models.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(cytotype = factor(cytotype, levels = cyt_levels)) %>%
  arrange(cytotype)

n_scanned <- nrow(slides_raw)
df <- slides_raw %>% filter(total_grains >= 100, sharp_grains >= 100)
n_slides <- nrow(df)
n_excl <- n_scanned - n_slides
n_plants <- n_distinct(df$plant_id)
n_pops <- n_distinct(df$population)
n_grains_total <- sum(df$total_grains, na.rm = TRUE)
n_grains_sharp <- sum(df$sharp_grains, na.rm = TRUE)

# 2. Load calibrated in-focus single-grain morphometry and apply 3D diameter scaling per cytotype
md_df <- read.csv(p_rel("output/qc/class_min_diam.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::select(cytotype, class_name, min_diam_um)
ct_df <- read.csv(p_rel("output/qc/class_conf_threshold.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::select(cytotype, class_name, conf_threshold)
k3d_map <- m3d_cyt %>% dplyr::select(cytotype, k_diam_3d, k_vol_3d_total) %>% mutate(cytotype = as.character(cytotype))
grains_raw <- read.csv(p_rel("output/size_analysis/pollen_grain_measurements.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
gf_df <- read.csv(gzfile(p_rel("output/qc/grain_focus_flags.csv.gz")), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::select(slide_name, grain_id, norm_sharpness)

grains_clean <- grains_raw %>%
  left_join(gf_df, by = c("slide_name", "grain_id")) %>%
  left_join(md_df, by = c("cytotype", "class_name")) %>%
  left_join(ct_df, by = c("cytotype", "class_name")) %>%
  left_join(k3d_map, by = "cytotype") %>%
  filter(
    is.na(norm_sharpness) | norm_sharpness >= 3.50,
    valid_for_size == 1,
    slide_name %in% df$slide_name,
    class_name %in% c("viable", "non_viable"),
    is.na(min_diam_um) | diameter_um >= min_diam_um,
    is.na(conf_threshold) | conf >= conf_threshold
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    diam_3d_um = ifelse(class_name == "viable" & !is.na(k_diam_3d), diameter_um * k_diam_3d, diameter_um),
    cytotype = factor(cytotype, levels = cyt_levels),
    class_label = factor(class_name, levels = c("viable", "non_viable"), labels = c("Viable", "Non-viable"))
  )

n_grains_size <- nrow(grains_clean)

# 3. Unified LMER models: trait ~ cytotype + (1|population) + (1|cultivation_run) + (1|population:plant_id)
ctrl <- lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")
m_diam3d <- lmer(viable_diam_3d_um ~ cytotype + (1 | population) + (1 | cultivation_run) + (1 | population:plant_id), data = df, control = ctrl)
m_vol3d  <- lmer(viable_vol_3d_mesh_median_um3 ~ cytotype + (1 | population) + (1 | cultivation_run) + (1 | population:plant_id), data = df, control = ctrl)
m_diam2d <- lmer(viable_median_diam_um ~ cytotype + (1 | population) + (1 | cultivation_run) + (1 | population:plant_id), data = df, control = ctrl)
m_viab   <- lmer(viability_pct ~ cytotype + (1 | population) + (1 | cultivation_run) + (1 | population:plant_id), data = df, control = ctrl)
m_abund  <- lmer(log10(total_grains) ~ cytotype + (1 | population) + (1 | cultivation_run) + (1 | population:plant_id), data = df, control = ctrl)

get_emm_cld <- function(mod, is_log10 = FALSE) {
  emm <- if (is_log10) emmeans(mod, ~ cytotype, type = "response") else emmeans(mod, ~ cytotype)
  res <- as.data.frame(cld(emm, Letters = letters))
  if ("response" %in% names(res)) res <- res %>% rename(emmean = response)
  lcl <- intersect(c("lower.CL", "asymp.LCL"), names(res))[1]
  ucl <- intersect(c("upper.CL", "asymp.UCL"), names(res))[1]
  res$lcl <- res[[lcl]]
  res$ucl <- res[[ucl]]
  res$.group <- trimws(res$.group)
  attr(res, "emm_raw") <- emmeans(mod, ~ cytotype)
  res
}

cld_list <- list(
  diam3d = get_emm_cld(m_diam3d, FALSE),
  vol3d  = get_emm_cld(m_vol3d, FALSE),
  diam2d = get_emm_cld(m_diam2d, FALSE),
  viab   = get_emm_cld(m_viab, FALSE),
  abund  = get_emm_cld(m_abund, TRUE)
)

e_val <- function(tr, cyt) cld_list[[tr]]$emmean[cld_list[[tr]]$cytotype == cyt]
pct_vs <- function(tr, a, b = "nat_2x") sprintf("%+.1f%%", 100 * (e_val(tr, a) / e_val(tr, b) - 1))
f1 <- function(x) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 1)
f2 <- function(x) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 2)
```

## Summary

We automatically segmented, classified, focus-screened, and reconstructed 2D/3D pollen morphometry across **`r n_slides` whole-slide scans** from **`r n_plants` flowering plants** across **`r n_pops` populations** (`AA012`, `AA025`, `AA225`, `AA310`, `AA372`; two F2 cohorts `run1_F2` and `run3_F2`; four cytotypes). Out of **540 cultivated plants**, **36 never flowered** and **504 flowered** (`r n_scanned` scanned slides, 2 sister coverslips per flower); **31 whole-slide scans** were excluded (**22 low-count pipetting-failure slides** with `< 100` total grains — losing **3 plants** that had `< 100` grains on both slides — and **9 wholly blurred slides** with `< 100` in-focus grains — losing **1 plant**, as the paired sister slide rescued the other 7), retaining **`r n_slides` slides across `r n_plants` of 504 flowering plants** (`477` plants with both sister slides, `23` with one passing slide). Across all scans, **`2,186,245` calibrated grains** were detected (**`r format(n_grains_total, big.mark = ",")`** on the `r n_slides` retained slides, used for per-slide abundance); removing **`260,729` (`11.9%`) locally out-of-focus grains** (`norm_sharpness < 3.50`) left **`r format(n_grains_sharp, big.mark = ",")` sharp grains** for viability % and **`r format(n_grains_size, big.mark = ",")` sharp isolated single grains** for 2D/3D morphometry. Key biological findings:

- **Exact 1:1 karyoplasmic 3D volume doubling in `neo_4x` followed by evolutionary downsizing in `nat_4x` ($p < 0.0001$).** Stereological 3D unfolding across $1.57\text{ million}$ in-focus hydrated viable grains shows homologous **`prolate-spheroidal`** 3D geometry across all four cytotypes ($\tau = 0.73\text{–}0.75$, $k_{\text{vol,3D}} = 0.993\text{–}0.998$). Newly synthesized `neo_4x` exhibits textbook isometric genome-to-volume doubling over diploid `nat_2x` (canonical 3D grain volume **`7,256 µm³` vs. `3,674 µm³` = `+97.5%` / $1.98\times$**; mixed-model EMM `r format(round(e_val("vol3d", "neo_4x")), big.mark = ",")` vs. `r format(round(e_val("vol3d", "nat_2x")), big.mark = ",")` µm³, `r pct_vs("vol3d", "neo_4x")`; 3D diameter `r f2(e_val("diam3d", "neo_4x"))` vs. `r f2(e_val("diam3d", "nat_2x"))` µm). Established `nat_4x` downsizes roughly halfway back toward diploids (`5,203 µm³` canonical, `+41.6%` / $1.42\times$; EMM `r format(round(e_val("vol3d", "nat_4x")), big.mark = ",")` µm³, `r pct_vs("vol3d", "nat_4x")` vs. `nat_2x`, $p < 0.0001$ vs. `neo_4x`), while `ory_2x` (`r f2(e_val("diam3d", "ory_2x"))` µm, `3,770 µm³` canonical) matches `nat_2x` ($p = 0.67$).
- **High male gametophyte fertility is maintained after polyploidization ($p = 0.23$).** All four cytotypes exhibit uniformly high in-focus pollen viability (`neo_4x`: `r f1(e_val("viab", "neo_4x"))`%, `nat_2x`: `r f1(e_val("viab", "nat_2x"))`%, `nat_4x`: `r f1(e_val("viab", "nat_4x"))`%, `ory_2x`: `r f1(e_val("viab", "ory_2x"))`% EMM; raw slide medians `98.1%–98.8%`, all Tukey group `a`).
- **Pollen production per flower does not collapse in neotetraploids ($p = 0.010$ overall).** Calibrated grain counts per slide average `r format(round(e_val("abund", "neo_4x")), big.mark = ",")` in `neo_4x` vs. `r format(round(e_val("abund", "nat_2x")), big.mark = ",")` in `nat_2x` ($p = 0.50$) and `r format(round(e_val("abund", "ory_2x")), big.mark = ",")` in `ory_2x` ($p = 0.99$), while established `nat_4x` produces the highest output (`r format(round(e_val("abund", "nat_4x")), big.mark = ",")` grains/slide; $p = 0.006$ vs. `neo_4x`).
- **Isometric within-cytotype size–number trade-off, shifted upward by polyploidy ($p < 10^{-15}$).** Within every cytotype, plants producing larger 3D pollen grains produce proportionally fewer grains per flower with a mixed-model log–log diameter slope of **$-3.27 \pm 0.24$ ($p < 10^{-37}$)** — matching isometric $D^{-3}$ biovolume conservation (`nat_2x`: $r = -0.49, p < 0.0001$; `nat_4x`: $r = -0.31, p = 0.0007$; `ory_2x`: $r = -0.26, p = 0.014$; `neo_4x`: $r = -0.23, p = 0.0045$). Polyploidization shifts this entire curve upward by $+0.24\text{ to }+0.27\text{ log}_{10}$ units ($\sim 1.72\text{–}1.88\times$ more grains at a given grain size; `nat_4x` $p = 2.9 \times 10^{-8}$, `neo_4x` $p = 6.3 \times 10^{-14}$ vs. diploids).

## Results

**Table 1.** Cytotype summary: linear mixed-model estimated marginal means (`EMM` with Tukey group in parentheses; $p < 0.05$) and raw slide median viability across $977$ QC-passing slides from $500$ plants.

```{r table-emms}
med_tab <- df %>%
  group_by(cytotype) %>%
  summarise(
    n_sl = n(),
    n_pl = n_distinct(plant_id),
    med_viab = median(viability_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

fmt_emm <- function(tr, digits = 1, big = FALSE, suffix = "") {
  d <- cld_list[[tr]]
  unname(sapply(cyt_levels, function(c) {
    r <- d[d$cytotype == c, ]
    v <- if (big) format(round(r$emmean), big.mark = ",") else formatC(r$emmean, format = "f", digits = digits)
    sprintf("%s%s (%s)", v, suffix, r$.group)
  }))
}

t1 <- data.frame(
  Cytotype = cyt_levels,
  Slides_Plants = sprintf("%d (%d)", med_tab$n_sl, med_tab$n_pl),
  Diam3D = fmt_emm("diam3d", 2),
  Vol3D  = fmt_emm("vol3d", 0, big = TRUE),
  Diam2D = fmt_emm("diam2d", 2),
  Viab_EMM = fmt_emm("viab", 1, suffix = "%"),
  Viab_Med = sprintf("%.1f%%", med_tab$med_viab),
  Abund = fmt_emm("abund", 0, big = TRUE),
  row.names = NULL
)

kable(
  t1,
  row.names = FALSE,
  col.names = c("Cytotype", "Slides (Plants)", "3D Diam. (µm)", "3D Vol. (µm³)", "2D Diam. (µm)", "Viab. EMM", "Median Viab.", "Grains / Slide"),
  align = "llcccccc"
)
```

**Table 2.** Selected pairwise cytotype differences (first minus second cytotype, Tukey-adjusted across linear mixed models; `***` $p < 0.001$, `*` $p < 0.05$, `ns` not significant).

```{r table-contrasts}
keep_con <- c("nat_4x - nat_2x", "neo_4x - nat_2x", "neo_4x - nat_4x", "ory_2x - nat_2x")
stars <- function(p) as.character(cut(p, c(-Inf, .001, .01, .05, Inf), labels = c("***", "**", "*", "ns")))
flip_c <- function(x) paste(rev(strsplit(x, " - ")[[1]]), collapse = " - ")

fmt_con <- function(tr, digits = 2, is_log10 = FALSE, big = FALSE) {
  emm_raw <- attr(cld_list[[tr]], "emm_raw")
  pr <- as.data.frame(pairs(emm_raw, adjust = "tukey")) %>%
    mutate(
      contrast = gsub("[()]", "", as.character(contrast)),
      rev_c = vapply(contrast, flip_c, ""),
      est = ifelse(contrast %in% keep_con, estimate, -estimate),
      contrast = ifelse(contrast %in% keep_con, contrast, rev_c)
    ) %>%
    filter(contrast %in% keep_con)
  unname(sapply(keep_con, function(k) {
    r <- pr[pr$contrast == k, ]
    if (is_log10) {
      ratio_pct <- 100 * (10^r$est - 1)
      sprintf("%+.1f%% %s", ratio_pct, stars(r$p.value))
    } else if (big) {
      sgn <- ifelse(r$est >= 0, "+", "−")
      sprintf("%s%s %s", sgn, format(round(abs(r$est)), big.mark = ","), stars(r$p.value))
    } else {
      sprintf("%+.*f %s", digits, r$est, stars(r$p.value))
    }
  }))
}

t2 <- data.frame(
  Contrast = gsub(" - ", " vs. ", keep_con),
  Diam3D = fmt_con("diam3d", 2),
  Vol3D  = fmt_con("vol3d", 0, big = TRUE),
  Viab   = fmt_con("viab", 2),
  Abund  = fmt_con("abund", 1, is_log10 = TRUE),
  row.names = NULL
)

kable(
  t2,
  row.names = FALSE,
  col.names = c("Comparison", "Δ 3D Diam (µm)", "Δ 3D Vol. (µm³)", "Δ Viability (pp)", "Δ Grains / Slide"),
  align = "lcccc"
)
```

**Table 4.** Phenotypic variance decomposition across biological and experimental levels (% of slide-level variance explained; Nakagawa & Schielzeth 2013).

```{r table-variance}
decomp_one <- function(mod) {
  vc <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(mod))
  v_plant <- vc$vcov[vc$grp == "population:plant_id"]
  v_pop   <- vc$vcov[vc$grp == "population"]
  v_run   <- vc$vcov[vc$grp == "cultivation_run"]
  v_res   <- vc$vcov[vc$grp == "Residual"]
  v_fix   <- var(predict(mod, re.form = NA))
  v_tot   <- v_fix + v_pop + v_run + v_plant + v_res
  pcts <- 100 * c(
    v_fix, v_pop, v_run, v_plant, v_res,
    v_fix, v_fix + v_pop + v_run + v_plant
  ) / v_tot
  sprintf("%.1f%%", pcts)
}

t3 <- data.frame(
  Source = c(
    "Cytotype (Ploidy fixed effect)",
    "Population of origin",
    "Cultivation cohort",
    "Plant ID (within population)",
    "Residual (between sister slides)",
    "**Marginal R²m (Fixed effects)**",
    "**Conditional R²c (Full model)**"
  ),
  Diam3D = decomp_one(m_diam3d),
  Vol3D  = decomp_one(m_vol3d),
  Viab   = decomp_one(m_viab),
  Abund  = decomp_one(m_abund),
  row.names = NULL
)

kable(
  t3,
  row.names = FALSE,
  col.names = c("Source of Variation", "3D Diam", "3D Volume", "Viability (%)", "Log10(Grains)"),
  align = "lcccc"
)
```

```{r fig-traits}
#| fig-cap: "Slide-level distributions of 3D-corrected viable pollen diameter, 3D closed-mesh viable grain volume, pollen viability, and total calibrated grains per slide across cytotypes (N = 977 slides from 500 plants). Coloured boxes show slide-level interquartile ranges; white diamonds with error bars indicate linear mixed-model EMMs ± 95% CI; bold letters denote Tukey-adjusted compact letter displays (p < 0.05)."
#| fig-width: 7.0

trait_meta <- tibble(
  key = c("diam3d", "vol3d", "viab", "abund"),
  col = c("viable_diam_3d_um", "viable_vol_3d_mesh_median_um3", "viability_pct", "total_grains"),
  panel = factor(
    c("3D viable pollen diameter (µm)", "3D viable grain volume (µm³)", "Pollen viability (%)", "Pollen abundance (grains / slide)"),
    levels = c("3D viable pollen diameter (µm)", "3D viable grain volume (µm³)", "Pollen viability (%)", "Pollen abundance (grains / slide)")
  )
)

long_df <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(trait_meta)), function(i) {
  tibble(
    cytotype = df$cytotype,
    panel = trait_meta$panel[i],
    value = df[[trait_meta$col[i]]]
  )
})) %>% filter(!is.na(value))

cld_plot <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(trait_meta)), function(i) {
  k <- trait_meta$key[i]
  cld_list[[k]] %>% mutate(panel = trait_meta$panel[i])
}))

panel_tops <- long_df %>%
  group_by(panel) %>%
  summarise(y_max = max(value, na.rm = TRUE), y_min = min(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

cld_plot <- cld_plot %>%
  left_join(panel_tops, by = "panel") %>%
  mutate(y_lbl = y_max + 0.08 * (y_max - y_min))

ggplot(long_df, aes(cytotype, value, fill = cytotype)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.52, alpha = 0.72, outlier.size = 0.45, outlier.alpha = 0.30, colour = "#374151", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_errorbar(data = cld_plot, inherit.aes = FALSE, aes(cytotype, ymin = lcl, ymax = ucl), width = 0.14, linewidth = 0.45) +
  geom_point(data = cld_plot, inherit.aes = FALSE, aes(cytotype, emmean), shape = 23, size = 2.4, fill = "white", stroke = 0.5) +
  geom_text(data = cld_plot, inherit.aes = FALSE, aes(cytotype, y = y_lbl, label = .group), fontface = "bold", size = 3.3, vjust = 0) +
  facet_wrap(~ panel, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cyt_cols, guide = "none") +
```

```{r fig-single-grain}
pm <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(viable_diam_3d_um), !is.na(total_grains)) %>%
  group_by(plant_id, cytotype) %>%
  summarise(
    diam3d = mean(viable_diam_3d_um, na.rm = TRUE),
    grains = mean(total_grains, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

p_b <- ggplot(pm, aes(diam3d, grains, colour = cytotype)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.55, size = 1.35) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.85) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cyt_cols) +
  labs(
    title = "B. Plant-level size–number trade-off",
    x = "Mean 3D viable diameter (µm)",
    y = "Mean grains / slide (log10)",
    colour = NULL
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9.5))

p_a + p_b
```

```{r table-versions}
vh <- data.frame(
```

**Table 6.** Calibrated pipeline accuracy across $154$ unseen tiles ($200$ blind reviews: $100$ Jakub + $100$ Eliška, $2,595$ evaluated grains; pre-filter raw precision $97.2\%$, recall $99.2\%$, raw E2E $95.5\%$, calibrated E2E $96.3\%$). On $46$ shared double-blind tiles, human inter-rater concordance reached $r = 0.999$ for count and $r = 0.947$ for viability (median $|\Delta| = 0.00\text{ pp}$, mean $|\Delta| = 1.77\text{ pp}$).

```{r table-blind-qc}
qc_cyt <- read.csv(p_rel("output/qc/qc_summary_cytotype.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
qc_json <- fromJSON(p_rel("output/qc/viability_qc_r3_summary.json"))

qc_rows <- lapply(c(cyt_levels, "ALL"), function(k) {
  r <- qc_json$by_cytotype[[k]]
  if (is.null(r)) return(NULL)
  cal <- qc_cyt[qc_cyt$cytotype == k, ]
  is_all <- (k == "ALL")
  n_rev <- if (!is_all && nrow(cal)) round(cal$Det_tiles_checked[1]) else round(sum(qc_cyt$Det_tiles_checked))
  cal_p <- if (nrow(cal)) sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * cal$Det_precision[1]) else sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * mean(qc_cyt$Det_precision))
  cal_r <- if (nrow(cal)) sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * cal$Det_recall[1]) else sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * mean(qc_cyt$Det_recall))
  cal_c <- if (nrow(cal)) sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * cal$Det_class_accuracy[1]) else sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * mean(qc_cyt$Det_class_accuracy))
  poly_a <- sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * r$poly_accuracy)
  cal_b <- if (nrow(cal)) sprintf("%+.2f pp", cal$Det_viability_bias_pp[1]) else sprintf("%+.2f pp", mean(qc_cyt$Det_viability_bias_pp))
  wrap_b <- function(s) if (is_all) paste0("**", s, "**") else as.character(s)
  data.frame(
    Cytotype = wrap_b(ifelse(is_all, "All / Mean", k)),
    Reviews = wrap_b(n_rev),
    Grains = wrap_b(format(r$n_pred, big.mark = ",")),
    Precision = wrap_b(cal_p),
    Recall = wrap_b(cal_r),
    Class_Acc = wrap_b(cal_c),
    Poly_Acc = wrap_b(poly_a),
    Bias = wrap_b(cal_b)
  )
}) %>% bind_rows()

kable(
  qc_rows,
  row.names = FALSE,
  col.names = c("Cytotype", "Reviews", "Grains", "Precision", "Recall", "3-Class Acc.", "Polygon Acc.", "Viability Bias"),
  align = "lccccccc"
)
```

**Table 7.** Error-propagation sensitivity check: mixed-model $F$-tests and per-cytotype Tukey groupings ($p < 0.05$) before vs. after adjusting slides by pooled two-reviewer calibration or Reviewer 2 (Eliška) raw deviations.

```{r table-sensitivity}
rv_all <- read.csv(p_rel("output/qc/viability_qc_r3_final.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
el_b <- rv_all %>%
  filter(reviewer == "eliska") %>%
  group_by(cytotype) %>%
  summarise(
    el_bias = mean(viability_bias_pp, na.rm = TRUE),
    el_p = (sum(n_pred) - sum(fp)) / sum(n_pred),
    el_r = (sum(n_pred) - sum(fp)) / (sum(n_pred) - sum(fp) + sum(missed)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

sens_df <- df %>%
  left_join(el_b, by = "cytotype") %>%
  mutate(
    viab_adj = pmin(100, pmax(0, viability_pct - Det_viability_bias_pp)),
    count_adj = total_grains * Det_precision / Det_recall,
    viab_el = pmin(100, pmax(0, viability_pct - el_bias)),
    count_el = total_grains * el_p / el_r
  )

mv0 <- lmer(viability_pct ~ cytotype + (1 | population) + (1 | cultivation_run) + (1 | population:plant_id), data = sens_df, control = ctrl)
mv1 <- lmer(viab_adj ~ cytotype + (1 | population) + (1 | cultivation_run) + (1 | population:plant_id), data = sens_df, control = ctrl)
mv2 <- lmer(viab_el ~ cytotype + (1 | population) + (1 | cultivation_run) + (1 | population:plant_id), data = sens_df, control = ctrl)
mc0 <- lmer(log10(total_grains) ~ cytotype + (1 | population) + (1 | cultivation_run) + (1 | population:plant_id), data = sens_df, control = ctrl)
mc1 <- lmer(log10(count_adj) ~ cytotype + (1 | population) + (1 | cultivation_run) + (1 | population:plant_id), data = sens_df, control = ctrl)
mc2 <- lmer(log10(count_el) ~ cytotype + (1 | population) + (1 | cultivation_run) + (1 | population:plant_id), data = sens_df, control = ctrl)

cld_vec <- function(m) {
  d <- as.data.frame(cld(emmeans(m, ~ cytotype), Letters = letters))
  trimws(d$.group[match(cyt_levels, as.character(d$cytotype))])
}

mods_s <- list(mv0, mv1, mv2, mc0, mc1, mc2)
clds_mat <- do.call(rbind, lapply(mods_s, cld_vec))
avs <- lapply(mods_s, anova)

t_sens <- data.frame(
  Trait = c(rep("Pollen viability (%)", 3), rep("Log10(Grains / slide)", 3)),
  Spec = rep(c("Unadjusted pipeline", "2-reviewer calibrated", "Eliška strict raw"), 2),
  F_val = sapply(avs, function(a) sprintf("%.2f", a$`F value`[1])),
  p_val = sapply(avs, function(a) sprintf("%.3f", a$`Pr(>F)`[1])),
  ory_2x = clds_mat[, 1],
  nat_2x = clds_mat[, 2],
  nat_4x = clds_mat[, 3],
  neo_4x = clds_mat[, 4],
  row.names = NULL
)

kable(
  t_sens,
  row.names = FALSE,
  col.names = c("Trait", "Validation Adjustment", "LMER F", "p-value", "ory_2x", "nat_2x", "nat_4x", "neo_4x"),
  align = "llcccccc"
)
```

## Manuscript Materials & Methods (Short Version — Ready for Main Text)

**Automated pollen viability and 3D morphometric phenotyping.** Pollen production, gametophyte viability, and three-dimensional (3D) grain size were quantified across 1,008 whole-slide brightfield scans (two sister slides per flower across 504 flowering plants out of 540 cultivated individuals — 36 plants never flowered — spanning four cytotypes: `ory_2x`, `nat_2x`, `nat_4x`, and `neo_4x` across five *Arabidopsis* populations: `AA012`, `AA025`, `AA225`, `AA310`, and `AA372`, and two F2 cohorts: `run1_F2` and `run3_F2`). Mature anthers at anthesis were stained using Alexander's differential protocol (Alexander, 1969), distinguishing cytoplasm-filled **viable** pollen (dark magenta), empty **non-viable** microspores (turquoise/green cell walls), and partially stained **intermediate** grains. Whole coverslips were scanned on an automated Zeiss Axio Scan.Z1 microscope at $0.8772\,\mu\text{m px}^{-1}$ and analyzed in overlapping $640 \times 640\text{ px}$ tiles ($64\text{ px}$ overlap; 265,520 tiles total) using a three-class `YOLOv11m-seg` instance-segmentation model (Ultralytics; Jocher et al., 2023) trained over three active-learning rounds on 773 tiles (7,427 verified grain outlines plus 11.5% background/debris tiles) annotated with Segment Anything (`SAM`; Kirillov et al., 2023). Full-resolution grain outlines were smoothed without altering grain area, and detections straddling overlapping tile borders were merged ($\text{IoU} > 0.35$) to prevent double counting.

**Debris & focus filtering, 3D grain size reconstruction, validation, and statistical analysis.** To remove tiny stain precipitates without discarding naturally small shrunken aborted grains, minimum diameter and confidence thresholds were calibrated separately for each cytotype and viability class (`2,186,245` calibrated pollen grains across the `1,008` scans). Because local optical Z-defocus blurs dark viable pollen into pale brownish halos that inflate apparent grain diameter and mimic non-viable staining, each grain's contrast-normalized Laplacian sharpness ($100 \times \text{SD}(|\nabla^2 I|) / \Delta I$) was evaluated across all slides: locally out-of-focus grains ($< 3.50$; `260,729` detections, `11.9%`) were excluded before computing viability and grain size (`1,925,516` in-focus grains), while retaining total calibrated counts per slide for pollen abundance. At the slide level, 22 low-count pipetting-failure scans ($<100$ total grains; losing 3 plants with $<100$ grains on both sister slides) and 9 wholly out-of-focus scans ($<100$ sharp grains; losing 1 plant) were excluded, retaining **977 whole-slide scans across 500 of the 504 flowering plants** (477 plants with both sister slides and 23 with one passing sister slide; `2,179,117` calibrated and `1,924,830` in-focus grains). Grain size was measured on `r format(n_grains_size, big.mark = ",")` in-focus isolated single grains after excluding touching clumps and outer scan-border grains ($\text{solidity} \ge 0.88$, $\text{aspect ratio} \le 1.35$). To account for preferential gravitational settling of non-spherical grains onto microscope slides, we reconstructed 3D grain shape (Erdtman, 1952), 3D grain volume ($V_{3\text{D}}$), and 3D volume-equivalent spherical diameter ($D_{3\text{D}}$) per cytotype from the joint distribution of 2D grain diameters, ellipse aspect ratios, and polar vs. equatorial grain silhouettes (Supplementary Methods). Pipeline accuracy was evaluated blindly by two independent observers across 154 unseen tiles (100 tiles per observer, including 46 shared double-blind tiles; 200 tile-reviews and 2,595 evaluated grains, plus a 96-grain audit of the $\le \text{P2}$ and $\ge \text{P95}$ size tails). On the 46 shared tiles, inter-observer agreement reached $r = 0.999$ for grain count and $r = 0.947$ for viability (median $|\Delta| = 0.00\text{ pp}$, mean $|\Delta| = 1.77\text{ pp}$). Across all 200 blind reviews, the calibrated pipeline achieved **98.0% precision**, **99.0% recall**, **99.3% three-class accuracy**, and **97.5% single-grain outline accuracy** ($+1.48\text{ pp}$ mean viability bias, smaller than inter-observer human variation and verified to have no effect on mixed-model conclusions). Traits were analyzed with linear mixed-effects models (`lme4` / `lmerTest`; Bates et al., 2015) with fixed effect `cytotype`, random intercepts for population, cultivation cohort, and plant identity, variance partitioning ($R^2_m, R^2_c$; Nakagawa & Schielzeth, 2013), and Tukey-adjusted pairwise comparisons (`emmeans`; Piepho, 2004).

## Supplementary Methods: Pipeline Architecture, 3D Stereology & Model Reporting

1. **Whole-Slide Preparation & Imaging (`0.877242 µm/px`):** Out of 540 cultivated *Arabidopsis* individuals (`run1_F2` = 180, `run3_F2` = 360), 504 flowered at sampling (`run1_F2` = 176, `run3_F2` = 328; 36 non-flowering). Single-flower pollen suspensions stained with modified Alexander's reagent were divided into two independent coverslip aliquots (`primary` and `replicate`; 1,008 whole-slide scans total; 977 QC-passing sharp slides across 500 plants). Full coverslips were scanned in brightfield on a Zeiss Axio Scan.Z1 and tiled into coordinate-registered $640 \times 640\text{ px}$ JPEG crops ($\text{stride} = 576\text{ px}$, $64\text{ px}$ overlap; 265,520 tiles total in `s3://peg-bucket/Ostatni/Pollen_viability/tiles_640/`).
2. **Active-Learning Training & Post-Mosaic Checkpoint (`v3.1`):** A three-class `YOLOv11m-seg` model (`0: viable`, `1: non_viable`, `2: intermediate`) was trained in full FP32/TF32 precision (`amp = False`, AdamW, `lr0 = 0.0008`, cosine schedule, 200 epochs, 0 NaN epochs) on 773 sanitized tiles (7,427 polygons, incorporating 71 sharp SAM-annotated multi-cytotype interior tiles with `grain_focus_lap >= 35.0`, excluding `_tile_0_` borders and synthetic $4\times$ zoom on tetraploid slides, while holding out all 870 training/relabel tiles from blind QC). Mosaic augmentation was disabled for the final 25 epochs (`close_mosaic = 25`), and the full-scale refined checkpoint (`last_20261122_r3.pt`, MD5 `1ea93497105eee085848310df127e42f`) was promoted after halving false positives on hard QC tiles.
3. **Cluster Inference, Stitching, Two-Tier Calibration & Contrast-Normalized Focus Gate (`v2.1`):** Inference ran across 6 GPU shards on CERIT-SC (`CONF = 0.50`, NMS `IOU = 0.45`, containment $> 0.65$, `retina_masks = True`, area-preserving Chaikin corner-cutting, cross-tile stitching at $\text{IoU} > 0.35$, paginated across all 1,008 slide prefixes). Per-`(cytotype, class)` minimum diameter (`class_min_diam.csv`, retaining $>99\%$ of isolated reference microspores) and confidence (`class_conf_threshold.csv`) thresholds yielded 2,186,245 calibrated grains across 1,008 slides (`2,179,117` on the 977 retained slides). Per-grain contrast-normalized Laplacian sharpness ($100 \times \text{SD}(|\nabla^2 I|) / \max(18, P_{95} - P_{05}) \ge 3.50$) removed `260,729` (`11.9%`) locally Z-defocused grains without penalizing translucent sterile exine walls (`1,925,516` in-focus grains overall; `1,924,830` across 977 retained slides from 500 plants after excluding 22 sparse $<100$-grain slides [3 plants] and 9 blurred $<100$-sharp-grain slides [1 plant], halving sister-slide viability discordance from $6.24\text{ pp}$ to $3.20\text{ pp}$, median $1.01\text{ pp}$), leaving `r format(n_grains_size, big.mark = ",")` in-focus isolated single grains (`solidity >= 0.88`, `aspect_ratio <= 1.35`, $D_{2\text{D}} = 2\sqrt{A_{2\text{D}}/\pi}$) for morphometry.
4. **Two-Stage Stereological 3D Unfolding & Closed Surface-Mesh Reconstruction (`reconstruct_3d_cytotypes.py`):** Following the *Pollen Latitude* 3D pipeline (`reconstruct_3d_species.py`), 2D projection bias was corrected in two stages per cytotype:
   - *Stage 1 (Stereological axis & settling unfolding):* Using slide-normalized log-diameter $u = \ln(D_{2\text{D}} / D_{\text{slide,med}})$ and half-log aspect ratio $\delta = \frac{1}{2}\ln(a'/b')$ across 1,571,294 in-focus hydrated viable grains (529,299 `nat_2x`, 280,294 `ory_2x`, 333,330 `nat_4x`, 428,371 `neo_4x`), four nested 3D ellipsoid projection families (`sphere`, `prolate`, `oblate`, `triaxial`) with Boltzmann slide-settling parameter $\tau \in [0, 3.5]$, biological log-size SD $\sigma_g$, and contour noise $\sigma_e$ were fitted over $M = 600$ Fibonacci hemisphere orientations by minimizing 24-angle 2D Sliced Wasserstein Distance (requiring $\ge 8\%$ relative SWD gain over simpler models; 32 slide-block bootstraps for SEs). All four cytotypes converged to `prolate-spheroidal` shapes ($\tau = 0.73\text{–}0.75$), yielding stereological volume factors $k_{\text{ell,3D}} = (p\,q)/d_{\text{sim,med}}^3$ (`0.9951 ± 0.0011` in `ory_2x`, `0.9953 ± 0.0004` in `nat_2x`, `0.9917 ± 0.0003` in `nat_4x`, `0.9911 ± 0.0002` in `neo_4x`).
   - *Stage 2 (Fourier-aligned genus-0 3D mesh):* Up to 160 polar ($\le Q_{25}$ aspect ratio, aligned on 3-fold tricolpate Fourier phase) and 160 equatorial ($\ge Q_{75}$ aspect ratio) whole-grain contours per cytotype were sampled from S3 `_det.json` masks to construct closed triangulated Wavefront `.obj` meshes (`pollen_3d_meshes.zip`), yielding exact divergence-theorem lobation factor $\phi_{\text{mesh}}$ (`1.0013–1.0030`), 3D grain volume $V_{3\text{D,med}} = \frac{\pi}{6} D_{2\text{D,med}}^3 k_{\text{ell,3D}} \phi_{\text{mesh}}$, orientation-deconvolved mean grain volume $V_{3\text{D,mean}}$, and 3D volume-equivalent diameter $D_{3\text{D}} = (6 V_{3\text{D,med}}/\pi)^{1/3}$.
5. **Two-Reviewer Blinded Web Validation & Archiving:** Two independent reviewers (`jakub` = 100/100, `eliska` = 100/100; 46 shared double-blind overlap tiles; 0 image-issue rejections) audited 154 unseen tiles in `viability-review-stenc.dyn.cloud.e-infra.cz` (`r3_final_20261123_1702`, inter-rater $r = 0.999$ for count and $r = 0.947$ for viability, median $|\Delta| = 0.00\text{ pp}$, mean $|\Delta| = 1.77\text{ pp}$; plus 96 tail grains in `extremes_r3_20261124_1307`). S3 archiving (`s3://peg-bucket/Ostatni/Pollen_viability/`) and software stack: Python 3.12, Ultralytics 8.4, PyTorch, OpenCV, SciPy; R 4.4 (`lme4`, `lmerTest`, `emmeans`, `multcomp`, `MuMIn`, `ggplot2`, `patchwork`), Quarto 1.8.
